title: agropyron × duvalii
intro: Agropyron × duvalii, commonly known as Agropyron duvalii or its synonym, Thinopyrum intermedium, is a plant hybrid within the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron × duvalii include its role in regulating blood pressure, improving digestion, and providing relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
